invariantStatements: Configuration provenance is a read-only resolver; mutation stays under #1119.
Unknown source kinds and bare remote URLs fail closed.
No mutable URL-config truth path; remote config requires pre-bound origin, digest and hash.
A compose file in the repo is an un-inventoried deployment-config source and must be explicitly bound.
Secrets never enter receipts; they are projected only as a redacted identity.
This inventory is a claim surface: if concrete surfaces change it must be regenerated at the same revision.

surfaces.label: compiled-defaults
surfaces.note: Hardcoded defaults inside resolver call sites; lowest priority, always present.

surfaces.label: image-manifest
surfaces.note: Immutable image digest bound at build/deploy; read back via SOVEREIGN_IMAGE_DIGEST.

surfaces.label: deployment-config-env-template
surfaces.note: Revision-bound deploy template; not a mutable truth path.

surfaces.label: deployment-config-toolchain-template
surfaces.note: Toolchain patch-flow template; revision-bound deploy input.

surfaces.label: environment-projection-buildtime
surfaces.note: Build-time env (VITE_*, process.env, import.meta.env) baked at frontend build; projected read-only.

surfaces.label: approved-runtime-overlay
surfaces.note: Explicitly approved overlay only; highest priority, pre-bound externally.
